nodes.name: Compute circular two-body period
nodes.description: Compute positive orbital period from separation, both masses and explicit SI G under the isolated Newtonian circular-orbit model.

inputs.name: separation_metres
inputs.constraints: nonempty finite positive real separation in metres

inputs.name: mass1_kg
inputs.constraints: finite positive first mass in kilograms; same shape as separation

inputs.name: mass2_kg
inputs.constraints: finite positive second mass in kilograms; same shape as separation

inputs.name: gravitational_constant
inputs.constraints: finite positive scalar G in SI

outputs.name: period_seconds
outputs.constraints: positive finite float64 seconds; input shape preserved

metadata.physical_regime: Isolated Newtonian point masses in a circular orbit; separation is not a barycentric radius.
